newsitem.title: LATVIA: GAZPROM SAYS LATVIA IMPORTANT IN BALTIC GAS MKT.
newsitem.headline: GAZPROM SAYS LATVIA IMPORTANT IN BALTIC GAS MKT.

text.p: Russian gas giant Gazprom said on Wednesday that Latvia was set to play an important role in the gas market of the Baltic region.
Gazprom, the sole provider of natural gas to Latvia, earlier signed an agreement to buy 16.25 percent of Latvian Gas, the monopoly provider of gas in the Baltic state.
German firms Preussen and Ruhrgas formed a consortium to buy another 16.25 percent.

"By becoming part of this company we are reassuring the inhabitants of both Latvia and the Baltics that we are a secure partner," Gazprom chairman Rem Vyakhirov told a news conference after the Latvian Gas sale deal was signed.

"Gazprom sees the Baltic market as a single unit where Latvia due to its geography and its underground storage facilities will have the role of the distribution centre on the southern coast of the Baltic market," he added.
He said that Gazprom saw its role in Latvian Gas as a partner that would ensure deliveries of gas.
